clusters.title: Run-level gradFill (white-to-white) not resolved
clusters.symptom: A degenerate two-stop gradFill on a text run (both stops the same color, typically white) is not resolved at all; the run falls back to the theme's dark default text color instead of the gradient's color, killing contrast against colored fills.

clusters.title: Explicit run-level bold (b="1") not applied
clusters.symptom: Runs (and occasionally just a run's leading letter/prefix) that carry an explicit b="1" render at regular weight instead of bold. Affects titles, column headers, and body emphasis across four decks.

clusters.title: hidden="1" shapes drawn anyway
clusters.symptom: A shape whose p:cNvPr carries hidden="1" is rendered regardless, overlapping titles and content with stray captions and accent shapes that PowerPoint and LibreOffice correctly suppress.

clusters.title: a:grpFill (fill inherited from parent group) not resolved
clusters.symptom: A child shape (preset roundRect bar or custGeom icon) whose spPr defers its fill to a:grpFill, expecting the enclosing group's solidFill, instead renders with no fill at all — the shape becomes invisible, taking any overlaid white text or numbers with it.

clusters.title: Picture srcRect crop (and ellipse crop mask) ignored
clusters.symptom: A picture's a:srcRect crop, or an ellipse preset-geometry crop mask, is not applied; the full uncropped source bitmap is stretched into the frame instead, exposing content the crop was meant to hide (extra UI chrome, taglines, docked toolbars) or leaving square corners instead of round.

clusters.title: Parse p:style/a:fontRef and the clrMap/clrMapOvr colour map
clusters.symptom: Text whose color comes only from the shape's p:style/fontRef default, from a mapped scheme color resolved through the slide/layout color map, or from a layout clrMapOvr override renders in the theme's dark default text color instead of the correct (usually white/lt1) color. Bold headings and labels lose contrast or become invisible against colored fills.

clusters.title: Layout placeholder's own lstStyle/position override ignored
clusters.symptom: A placeholder whose layout defines its own size, position, and text style (lstStyle sz/b/color, or xfrm) instead inherits the master's generic titleStyle/bodyStyle, rendering far smaller, unbold, wrong-colored, mispositioned, and wrapped to the wrong number of lines.

clusters.title: Draw buChar bullet glyphs and honour the paragraph hanging indent
clusters.symptom: Paragraphs with an explicit or lstStyle-inherited buChar bullet render with no bullet marker at all, losing the list structure; marL is applied so the text columns are correct, but the indent attribute that positions the bullet is also dropped.

clusters.title: Text overflow/autofit semantics not implemented
clusters.symptom: When a text box has no autofit and is too short for its text, PowerPoint/LibreOffice let it visibly overflow the box; BetterOffice instead hard-clips at the box edge, or in a few cases silently shrinks the font to fit. A related spAutoFit case shows the box failing to grow to match its text instead.

clusters.title: DrawingML tables (a:tbl) not rendered at all
clusters.symptom: Every p:graphicFrame containing an a:tbl renders only as an empty dashed placeholder box labeled "Table" — no grid, cell fills, borders, or text — regardless of table size or style. The single largest and most consistently high-severity cluster in the dataset.

clusters.title: custGeom shapes render as their bounding-box rectangle
clusters.symptom: Any custGeom shape — whether its path is built from literal moveTo/lnTo/cubicBezTo points, legacy T-guide formulas, or connsiteX/Y guides — is drawn as a plain filled or unfilled axis-aligned rectangle spanning its a:off/a:ext box, discarding the actual outline. Icons, silhouettes, donut wedges, hexagons, country shapes, and decorative rules all reduce to rectangles or squares.

clusters.title: Picture fails to render at all (EMF/WMF, OLE fallback, one JPEG)
clusters.symptom: A p:pic (or an OLE object's mc:Fallback picture) whose blip resolves to an EMF or WMF image is skipped entirely — logged as a skipped image — leaving a blank area where a logo, chart fallback, or illustration should be.

clusters.title: Slide-number field renders literal placeholder glyph
clusters.symptom: The <a:fld type="slidenum"> field on a plain (non-placeholder) master/layout shape is drawn using its cached fallback text (‹#›) instead of being evaluated to the slide's number; all 23 slides of the deck show the identical literal. The cluster's "dingbat-like font substitution" sub-claim is not confirmed — slide 5 renders the same ‹#› at 6 pt.

clusters.title: Run-level character spacing (spc) ignored
clusters.symptom: The spc attribute on a:rPr (positive letter-spacing/tracking or negative kerning) is not applied. Text renders at default kerning; for larger tracking values this also shifts word-wrap points.

clusters.title: Alpha/opacity modifier on solid fills ignored
clusters.symptom: The alpha child on a schemeClr or srgbClr solidFill is dropped; translucent overlays, shadow shapes and layered backgrounds render fully opaque instead of blending with what is beneath them. Full-slide scrims turn whole slides into flat colour, hiding the photograph behind them.

clusters.title: Master title style's reduced line spacing (lnSpc) not applied
clusters.symptom: The master's titleStyle lnSpc override (80%) is not applied to two-line titles; the second line sits noticeably lower than spec, sagging into or being overdrawn by content below it.

clusters.title: Connector shapes (p:cxnSp) never parsed, so no connector is ever drawn
clusters.symptom: Every p:cxnSp is dropped by the shape-tree parser, so decorative rules, dividers, leader lines and arrow connectors never reach the renderer. A degenerate bounding box is not the trigger: non-degenerate diagonal connectors are dropped identically, and renaming p:cxnSp to p:sp makes them render correctly.

clusters.title: Chart data labels drawn even though show flags are all disabled
clusters.symptom: The plot group's c:dLbls block has every show* flag (showVal, showCatName, etc.) set to 0, yet BetterOffice still draws a numeric label at the end of every bar.

clusters.title: Run-level solidFill/formatting not scoped to its own run
clusters.symptom: On multi-run paragraphs, an explicit run-level solidFill (sometimes along with bold/underline) is lost from its own run or bleeds onto a neighboring run: text takes the wrong run's color, or the run's whole styling is dropped while an adjacent run's color leaks across the visual line.

clusters.title: buAutoNum auto-numbering not drawn
clusters.symptom: Paragraphs using buAutoNum (e.g. arabicPeriod) render with no number at all; the hanging indent is sometimes preserved but the "1."/"2." markers never appear.

clusters.title: Text orientation not corrected for shape rotation/flip
clusters.symptom: Text inside a shape rotated 180° with flipV="1" (or 90° with flipH) renders mirrored/reversed instead of staying upright; separately, text in a shape rotated via bodyPr vert="vert"/"vert270" renders sideways following the shape's raw rotation instead of the compensated vertical reading direction.

clusters.title: Non-solid fill types (radial gradFill, pattFill) collapse to a flat fill
clusters.symptom: A radial (circle-path) gradient background, or a pattern fill (pattFill, e.g. dot/grid patterns), renders as a single flat color — the outer gradient stop, or a plain fill in place of the pattern — instead of the actual gradient/pattern.

clusters.title: Connector/line stroke color not resolved from style or gradFill
clusters.symptom: A connector whose only stroke definition is the shape style's lnRef (no explicit a:ln), or whose explicit a:ln uses a gradFill instead of a solidFill, is drawn with no visible stroke at all — whole diagrams lose their connecting lines.

clusters.title: Chart value axis c:axPos not honored — axes swapped
clusters.symptom: A bar chart's value axis (axPos="b") is drawn in the left label column instead of along the bottom, crowding out and truncating the category axis labels.

clusters.title: Bar chart category order reversed top-to-bottom
clusters.symptom: For a horizontal bar chart with catAx orientation minMax, categories plot in ascending order top-to-bottom instead of the reference's descending order.

clusters.title: Theme/symbol font substitution differs from PowerPoint's, shifting wrap points
clusters.symptom: The theme's majorFont (+mj-lt, Calibri) resolves to a noticeably wider fallback face, so lines wrap one word earlier than the reference and titles/body text overflow their boxes or collide with content below; a Wingdings/PUA glyph used as a bullet icon also renders as a missing-glyph tofu box.

clusters.title: Misc run properties ignored (superscript baseline, italic)
clusters.symptom: A run's baseline="30000" (superscript) or i="1" (italic) flag is not applied; text renders on the baseline at full size, or upright instead of italic.

clusters.title: Preset geometry adjust values (chevron/homePlate notch) wrong
clusters.symptom: A chevron or homePlate preset shape's notch is drawn far deeper than its adj guide specifies, breaking the seamless overlap between adjacent banner shapes.

clusters.title: Chart legend position and title alignment not honored
clusters.symptom: A legend with legendPos="b" renders as a vertical list at the top-right instead of a horizontal row below the plot area; a centered chart title renders left-aligned to the frame edge instead.

clusters.title: Text warp (prstTxWarp) and outer shadow effects not applied
clusters.symptom: WordArt-style arc text (prstTxWarp textArchUp/Down) renders as straight horizontal/rotated text instead of following the curve; separately, an outerShdw drop shadow declared on marker shapes is not drawn at all.

clusters.title: Blip color effects (duotone, biLevel) not applied or crash the picture
clusters.symptom: A picture with a duotone or biLevel blip effect either ignores the effect (shows the original full-color raster) or disappears entirely instead of applying the recolor/threshold effect.

clusters.title: custGeom shape with a picture fill not drawn at all
clusters.symptom: A freeform custGeom whose fill is a blipFill (a picture-filled wordmark/letterform outline) is not drawn at all, not even as a bounding-box fallback — the whole decorative element vanishes.

clusters.title: Chart value-axis auto-scale doesn't round to friendly increments
clusters.symptom: When neither c:max/min nor c:majorUnit is specified, BetterOffice derives the axis scale directly from the raw data max/step instead of rounding to human-friendly increments, producing an odd scale (e.g. 12.3 by 3.075) instead of a rounded one.

clusters.title: Line chart series, axis labels, and noFill axis line all mis-rendered
clusters.symptom: A single chart's data series (line stroke and markers) is not drawn at all, its category/value axis tick labels are missing, and its axis line — explicitly set to noFill — is drawn anyway as a broken, segmented vertical stroke.

clusters.title: Group child rotation + anisotropic scale computed wrong
clusters.symptom: A custGeom shape inside a non-uniformly scaled, rotated group renders as an oversized diamond far larger than the circle it should shade, consistent with the child's own rotation and the group's chOff/chExt scale factors being combined incorrectly.
